question: Which event mentioned in the passage took place in the 1980s?

options.text: Documents of the annals about India's diversity
Partnership of Indian members of Relais & Chateaux and Slow Food International
Leaving of large carbon footprint by food

solution:
The correct answer is "**Beginning of Slow Food Movement**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The question asks about a **specific event** mentioned in the given passage.
 
• The correct option is **option 1) Beginning of Slow Food Movement**.
 
• The passage mentions that the **Slow Food Movement started in the 1980s** and aims to bring to the fore the connection of plate with people and the planet.
 
• Therefore,** option 1 **is the correct answer to this question.
